feeds.title: Water Use It Wisely
feeds.description: News & Events, Product updates, reviews from Water Use It Wisely (WUIW). Also covers articles on Environmental and Sustainability, Education, Gardening, Landscaping, Outdoors, Kids and more. WUIW is a community awareness campaign demonstrating how changing a few simple habits can have a significant impact on water consumption.

feeds.title: Waterwise News
feeds.description: Blog posts on saving water, water efficiency, eco-lifestyle, events, and more from Waterwise. Waterwise is a non-profit organization focused on lowering water consumption in the United Kingdom that provides independent and ambitious leadership to create social and political change.

feeds.title: AquaSwitch
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the current issues and latest news in the British Water Market. Contains guides and advice on switching your business water supplier. AquaSwitch provides a comparison and switching service that allows British businesses to benefit from deregulation of the water market.

feeds.title: Metron News
feeds.description: Useful tips and information to help you save water and money. WaterSignal measures water flow in real-time to detect leaks and conserve water.

feeds.description: Ideas, recommendations, and articles about how to save money on your water bills. Conservation Mart is your one-stop-shop for weatherization materials, energy-saving goods, and water-saving devices.
